claim: The workflow uses creation timestamps in an Excalidraw document to replay the drawing and export a WebM.
A browser automation tool generates the video and the command asks for human review before uploading it.
The speakers say a stable linear version of the workflow could instead be a shell script.
Keeping the agent involved allows natural language requests such as making the animation slower to become tool parameters.
The speakers advise keeping human taste and system design judgment engaged because fast code reading and writing do not ensure good code.
The testing infrastructure and developer workflow took longer to design than the code itself.
